description: 直通宽松版型、水洗做旧质感、加深口袋与双线锁边

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF paper sweep for packshot and trust screens, #BBDCEA flat panel for infographic screens, real weathered concrete tones #B0ADA8 and #D7DAD8 for lifestyle and pain-point screens, one thin #FFFFFF rule line as the only graphic divider
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool soft studio light, front-left key with fill on the shadow side, visible raking side light at 30 degrees across fabric to render twill weave, drape and stitch rows, soft contact shadow only, 5500K except lifestyle at 4800K
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte #43546A board for macro screens, flat #BBDCEA panel for spec screens, real concrete ground and steps for lifestyle, seamless sweep for hanging shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline in #2D2D2D at 28-34pt, label in #2D2D2D at 12-16pt, maximum one headline plus three proof chips per screen, rendered copy filled from the project's verified facts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line round icons, single stroke weight, drawn in #2F4B6E on #BBDCEA or #FFFFFF, no filled illustration, no 3D badges
styleLock.presentationRules: garment shown hanging, flat-laid, on a matched 90-degree overhead plane or cropped below the waist; waistband always at the top edge of the crop, legs fall vertical and unpressed; identical garment scale and centre placement across infographic panels; never a visible face or head
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors
no mixed fonts and no more than one headline per screen
no random backgrounds and no gradient sweeps
no inconsistent lighting and no flat shadowless macro shots
no mismatched icon styles and no 3D badges
no visible model face, head or recognizable identity
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool washed-denim workwear menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless #FFFFFF fields, washed denim tone #2F4B6E, info panel #BBDCEA and topstitch accent #C0762C, with all text in #2D2D2D; cool soft studio lighting, front-left key plus fill and a visible 30-degree raking side light across the fabric, soft contact shadow only; modern geometric sans-serif with thin-line round icons in #2F4B6E; real product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements, one headline plus at most three proof chips per screen; garment hung, flat-laid or cropped below the waist with the waistband at the top edge of the crop and legs falling vertical, stable garment scale and centre placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible faces.

shots.displayName: 白底挂拍水洗牛仔主图
shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用挂拍全景交代直通裤型与水洗层次，主图无任何文字。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, garment hung on a hanger, full length visible and not clipped by the frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow under the hem
shots.props: one matte hanger at the waistband, nothing else
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment hung from a matte hanger at a straight-on eye-level angle, full length visible, legs falling vertical and not clipped by the frame, natural drape with soft fold lines along the thigh. Bright even high-key studio light with a front-left key and soft fill, soft contact shadow under the hem so nothing floats. Seamless #FFFFFF paper sweep background. The garment occupies 35-40% of the frame. Negative: no model, no face, no hands, no props besides the hanger, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清核心主张：前幅与后幅平铺并置证明裤型，配三枚圆形短标签承接首屏。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down on two flat-laid views of the garment, front and back side by side
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with fill, gentle contact shadow under every garment edge
shots.background: flat #BBDCEA panel with one thin #FFFFFF rule line
shots.props: three thin-line round label chips only
shots.textZone: upper-right band holds the headline, the three round chips sit below it, garments occupy the lower-left to centre field
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic benefit screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two flat-laid views of the garment, front and back, laid side by side and squared, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down with identical scale on both. Headline in #2D2D2D at 34pt reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in the upper-right band, three thin-line round chips beneath it reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」, icons drawn in #2F4B6E. Soft front-left key with fill, gentle contact shadow under each garment edge, raking side light at 30 degrees showing the washed twill surface. Flat #BBDCEA panel background with one thin #FFFFFF rule line. The garment occupies 45-50% of the frame across the two views. Negative: no dense body text, no more than three claims, no model, no face, no invented measurements, no watermark, no fake logo, no gradient background.

shots.displayName: 紧绷卡裆裤型垮塌痛点屏
shots.intent: 放大普通窄脚裤紧绷、卡裆、膝部鼓包的穿着困扰，为宽松直通的解法做铺垫。
shots.camera: two matched panels, identical straight-on eye-level framing shot at hip height, cropped above the waist
shots.lighting: left panel flat overhead light that tightens every crease, right panel soft front-left key with fill, 5500K
shots.props: none, the two fabric states carry the contrast
shots.textZone: top band centred headline, one short label at the bottom of each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic pain-point screen with two matched panels, identical straight-on eye-level camera at hip height on both sides, every figure cropped above the waist. Left panel: an ordinary narrow trouser leg on a body, fabric pulled taut across the thigh, bunching below the knee and sagging at the seat, lit by flat overhead light so every strain line reads hard. Right panel: {product} on the same posture, fabric falling in a clean vertical line from hip to hem, lit by a soft front-left key with fill. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Headline in #2D2D2D at 30pt reading 「{selling_point_2}」 in the top band, one short label in #2D2D2D at 14pt at the bottom of each panel. Background flat #D7DAD8 on both panels. The garment occupies 40-50% of the frame across both panels. Negative: no face, no head, no recognizable person, no fabricated statistics, no exaggerated body claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text.

shots.displayName: 街角台阶腰下日常场景
shots.intent: 用腰以下裁切的低角度日常街拍让人代入，验证宽松直通裤型在真实光线下的垂坠。
shots.camera: very low angle from ankle height looking upward along the legs, framed from the waist down only
shots.lighting: late-afternoon daylight from the right at 4800K, long soft ground shadow, side light raking the twill
shots.background: weathered concrete wall #B0ADA8 and concrete steps
shots.props: concrete steps and a plain hem of a #FFFFFF tee at the top edge of the crop
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn on a lower body standing on worn concrete steps, photographed from a very low angle at ankle height looking upward along the legs. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Framed from the waist down only, so the head and torso stay out of the frame; legs relaxed and straight, hem resting naturally over the shoe without distortion. Late-afternoon daylight from the right at 4800K, long soft shadow on the ground, raking side light revealing the washed twill texture and the double-needle stitch rows. Weathered concrete wall #B0ADA8 behind, plain hem of a #FFFFFF tee at the top edge of the crop. Contact shadows where the soles meet the step. The garment occupies 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no face, no head, no recognizable model identity, no warped leg proportions, no floating feet, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.displayName: 腰头门襟双针缝线微距
shots.intent: 以腰头、门襟与缝线的微距证明做工密度与洗水层次，替材质主张提供肉眼可见的证据。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, shallow depth of field, foreground tack sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the left at 30 degrees, controlled single highlight along the seam ridge
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the waistband, belt loop, front closure and pocket opening, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the garment laid flat. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground seam tack sharp and the rear edge falling soft. Raking side light from the left at 30 degrees revealing the twill ridges, whiskered wash lines, puckering and double-needle stitch rows in {accent_color}. Matte #43546A board underneath. The detail occupies 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no blurry subject, no hands, no visible brand mark, no fake logo, no extra text, no watermark, no plastic-smooth over-retouched fabric, no duplicated stitch lines.

shots.displayName: 水洗丹宁与普通面料对比屏
shots.intent: 同框同光对比自家丹宁与参考面料的纹理与缝线整洁度，让品质差异一眼可读。
shots.camera: two matched circular swatch panels, straight-on at fabric height, identical crop and scale on both sides
shots.lighting: even diffused top light at 5500K with a low raking side light, no specular hotspot
shots.props: one circular mask per panel, no other props
shots.textZone: one label above each circular panel, a short proof line under both panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic comparison screen, two matched circular panels at the same size and the same straight-on angle taken at fabric height. Left panel: {product} shown as a tight swatch of its own washed twill surface, weave even, stitch rows clean and evenly spaced. Right panel: a generic ordinary twill reference swatch with loose, uneven weave and fraying stitch edge, used only as a visual contrast. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Labels in #2D2D2D at 16pt above the panels reading 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」, one short proof line in #2D2D2D at 12pt below reading 「{callout_6}」. Even diffused top light at 5500K plus a low raking side light, no specular hotspot. Flat #EDEDEA field background. The product fabric occupies 55-60% of the frame across the two panels. Negative: no fabricated lab data, no invented fibre percentages, no real competitor mark, no before-after skin or body claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled text.

shots.displayName: 量位与版型指数信息屏
shots.intent: 用平铺量位线与四档指数条回答尺码与厚薄弹力疑问，数值全部留作占位不臆造。
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, full length squared in frame
shots.lighting: even high-key flat light, no dramatic shadow, faint contact shadow along the garment edges
shots.props: dimension arrow lines and four five-cell index bars as layout elements
shots.textZone: garment on the left half with dimension lines, right column carries the headline and the four stacked index bars
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic size and fit spec screen: {product} laid flat and squared, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the full length in frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Thin dimension lines with arrowheads in #2D2D2D marking waist, hip, thigh, knee and hem, each value shown as a small rounded card reading 「{callout_7}」 and 「{callout_8}」; four stacked five-cell index bars in the right column, active cell filled #2F4B6E and inactive cells #D7DAD8, each bar labelled 「{callout_9}」; headline in #2D2D2D at 30pt reading 「{selling_point_3}」. Even high-key flat light, faint contact shadow along the garment edges. Flat #BBDCEA panel background. The garment occupies 35-40% of the frame. Negative: no invented measurements, no fabricated size numbers or fabric weights, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped straight lines, no cropped garment.

shots.intent: 以腰头、口袋、裤脚三栏同光细节与空白证明位收口，消除做工与品质顾虑。
shots.camera: three matched vertical panels photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile at waist, pocket and hem height
shots.lighting: directional side light from the left in every panel, identical strength and angle, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: headline across the top band, one label under each of the three panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic craft trust screen, three matched vertical panels photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile at waist height, pocket height and hem height, same crop and same light in all three. {product} appears once per panel as that section, {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Directional side light from the left revealing drape, seam rows and pocket depth, soft contact shadow. Headline in #2D2D2D at 28pt reading 「{selling_point_4}」 across the top band, three labels in #2D2D2D at 14pt under the panels reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」, thin-line icons in #2F4B6E. Seamless #FFFFFF sweep background. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame across the three panels. Negative: do not invent certifications, test reports, inspection numbers, awards or ratings, no dense certificate text, no real brand mark, no watermark, no fake logo, no face.

provenance.notes: 由 6 屏详情页长图切图逐屏提炼。重要改判：源图存放在「鞋靴」文件夹内，但逐屏核实主体商品是男士直通宽松水洗牛仔长裤（首屏品名标题即该类裤子，另有平铺裤装主图与裤装微距栏），模特脚上的鞋只是搭配道具，故归入男装/下装，不输出鞋靴模版。已剥离内容：原品牌与店铺字样、水印星标装饰、模特面部与身份、原文案与全部卖点词条、平铺与微距栏的独特排版、四档指数条的具体取值与尺码表全部数值、优与劣对比圈的原字面与棉田背景、末屏会员促销角标与二维码。图内文案一律改为 {selling_point_N} 与 {callout_N} 占位；面料成分百分比、克重、洗水参数、检测与认证、销量与评价均未编造。产品一律以 {product} 占位，换任意同类男装下装均可复用；机位方案走挂拍、平铺与腰下裁切，与修身、小脚类牛仔模版不重叠。
